The '''Verullia system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Kira sector/Legends|Kira sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of the [[Trailing Sectors/Legends|Trailing Sectors]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was home to the [[Species/Legends|creatures]] known as [[Verullian land slug]]s.<ref name="SW12" /><ref name="Planetnamia" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Verullia system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed it within grid square N-15.<ref name="TEA" />
